explanation: The response only restates the requested hypothesis components as placeholders. It recognizes the broad topic of improving strength and ductility in eutectic high-entropy alloys, but it neither reconstructs the HPHT intervention nor supplies an independently testable alternative. It omits the 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h treatment; hierarchical coherent-interface microstructure; dislocation-transfer and multi-mechanism plasticity rationale; approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% elongation targets; baseline comparison; pressure-dependent boundary; and discriminating EBSD/fractography measurements.
